stage0034_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「All units, spread out.
　$c is coming out.」

stage0034_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$メラン$$
「Neo Zeon has already deployed its forces.」

stage0034_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn you, $$シャア$$...!
　Right to Londenion, where Londo Bell's
　base is, so brazenly...!」

stage0034_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　To us, he's Captain $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$...
　Also known as Zeon's Red Comet...」

stage0034_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that red mobile suit...
　Captain $$クワトロ$$... no, $$シャア$$'s in it!?」

stage0034_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No...
　It's someone else piloting that.」

stage0034_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アルト$$
「But there's something about it...
　No doubt it's a serious threat...!」

stage0034_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$宗介$$
「Fast...!
　Almost 3x a standard suit's acceleration!」

stage0034_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch...!
　He's no ordinary fake, that guy!」

stage0034_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$レズン$$
（I don't like this, $$フル・フロンタル$$...
　Trying to drum up publicity for the Sleeves?）

stage0034_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To all units.
　The Commander needs 4 minutes to escape.」

stage0034_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Our objective is to hold the enemy for 4 minutes.
　...There's public opinion to consider.
　Don't damage the colony.」

stage0034_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, stay alert.
　Last time, he was just testing us,
　but today's different.」

stage0034_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（The one piloting that...
　The man who shot $$アムロ$$...
　A new Red Comet...）

stage0034_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「All units, begin the attack...!
　Show them Neo Zeon's strength!」

stage0034_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: the enemy force is wiped out.」

stage0034_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$オットー$$
「All that's left is to crush $$シャア$$!
　We end this war right here!」

stage0034_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$エマ$$
「$$レウルーラ$$...!
　Neo Zeon's flagship!」

stage0034_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$オットー$$
「They've come to pick up $$シャア$$!」

stage0034_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ヒル$$
「Confirmed: the Commander's party is recovered.」

stage0034_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「All ships, fall back!
　Recover the withdrawing units, then
　return straight to $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0034_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$アムロ$$, $$カミーユ$$... and $c...
　My war against humanity begins today...）

stage0034_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No, don't...
　Push too far and we'll just get hit back.」

stage0034_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...
　What are you even trying to do in this fight...）

stage0034_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Not bad, Unicorn...!
　Worthy of the Gundam name!」

stage0034_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No good...!
　Keep taking hits like this and I'm done for!」

stage0034_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That red suit's hostility is bearing down...!」

stage0034_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's that NT-D system they mentioned!」

stage0034_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Is the Unicorn reacting to the $$シナンジュ$$!）

stage0034_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Oh... So you finally show your true form.
　Seems I should count the pilot as part of the 'key.'」

stage0034_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll simply take it all...!」

stage0034_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$バナージ$$
「With this power... I can do it!!」

stage0034_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is as far as I go...
　Impressive, $c.」

stage0034_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The key to Laplace's Box...
　Seems I really will need to take
　the pilot along with it.」

stage0034_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is as far as I go...
　Impressive, $c.」

stage0034_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Leaving this unit in charge
　of the key to Laplace's Box may be risky...」

stage0034_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Before it's too late,
　perhaps I should take the pilot too...」

stage0034_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$エマ$$
「That red mobile suit's pilot...
　might be even better than Captain $$クワトロ$$.」

stage0034_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シン$$
「A new Red Comet...
　I think they called him $$フル・フロンタル$$...」

stage0034_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this unease...
　That man... what's his connection to $$シャア$$...）

stage0034_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$レズン$$
「Slipped up, did I!
　Guess he's as good as the rumors say!」

stage0034_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$レズン$$
「Londo Bell and $c!
　Feels like this'll be a long relationship!」

stage0034_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This red mobile suit...!
　It's on a whole different level!」

stage0034_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Compared to our last fight,
　your movements have loosened up.」

stage0034_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A shame.
　Keep growing like this and you'll be a fine pilot.」

stage0034_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now that the system's activated,
　holding back would put me at risk...!」

stage0034_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What...!?
　I can feel that pilot's hostility!」

stage0034_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Kill or be killed...!
　Is that the kind of fight this is!」

stage0034_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can tell clearly now...!
　You're not Captain $$クワトロ$$!」

stage0034_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Hearing you say that,
　seems you've mistaken me, if only a little,
　for the Commander. I'm honored, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

stage0034_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why do you know my name...!?」

stage0034_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Naturally.
　I know a great deal about you too.」

stage0034_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A presence just like $$シャア$$'s...!
　Just who are you!?」

stage0034_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Why don't you find that out for yourself, $$アムロ$$.」

stage0034_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter how good you are,
　a mobile suit that pathetic
　can't beat my $$シナンジュ$$!」

stage0034_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シン$$
「You people...!
　Why start a war like this!?」

stage0034_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A foolish question from someone of $$プラント$$.
　We rose bearing the will
　of every Spacenoid.」

stage0034_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't just assume that!
　The people I know have been trying
　to avoid war!」

stage0034_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シン$$
「You people trampled on their hopes,
　and I won't forgive that!」

stage0034_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Your desperate act, awakening
　the citizens' will to fight... Well done.」

stage0034_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A strange man...
　I feel no heat at all when I fight him...」

stage0034_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Your impression is a fair one.
　But I too have a role that must be fulfilled.」

stage0034_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「This man... just what is he...」

stage0034_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I heard about this man from $$シン$$...!
　So he's the new masked man!」

stage0034_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ゼクス・マーキス$$...
　No, Milliardo Peacecraft.
　Weren't you once the same as me?」

stage0034_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's exactly why I understand...!
　Just how dangerous a masked man can be!」

stage0034_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Me, who wears a mask, and you,
　who cast one aside... An amusing twist of fate.」

stage0034_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$レズン$$
「Well then... shall we?
　Let me see what you're made of.」

stage0034_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$レズン$$
「If you're called Bell, you should just ring one!」
